## How to Change Font Size of Slider?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-font-size-of-slider/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

You can manage the font size of the Slider Title, Slider Content, and Slider Content.

Follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, go to **Appearance **-> **Customize **-> ** Slider**
- Scroll to locate **Typography.**
- Change the font size of the desired section.
- Click on **Publish**.

---

## How to Change the Font Size of Footer?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-the-font-size-of-footer/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

You can manage font size of Footer widget title, Footer widget content, Footer Copyright text and Footer Menu.

To manage the Footer Widget Area , follow the steps listed below :

- From your WordPress Dashboard, go to **Appearance **-> **Customize -> Footer -> Footer Widgets Area**
- Scroll to **Typography**
- Change the font size of the desired section in the footer.
- Click on **Publish**.

To manage the Footer Bottom Bar section, follow the steps below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, go to **Appearance **-> **Customize -> Footer -> Footer Bottom Bar**
- Scroll to **Typography**
- Change the font size of the desired section in the footer.
- Click on **Publish**.

---

## How to Change the Font Size of Content?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-the-font-size-of-content/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

You can manage the font size of Content, Read More link , Sidebar Widgets and the Post Meta.

To manage the font size of Content , follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, go to **Appearance **-> **Customize **->** Content -> Comments**
- Scroll to locate **Typography. **
- Change the font size of the desired section.
- Click on **Publish**.

To manage the font size of Post Meta , follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, go to **Appearance **-> **Customize **->** Content -> Post Meta.**
- Scroll to locate **Typography. **
- Change the font size of the desired section.
- Click on **Publish**.

To manage the font size of Read More , follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, go to **Appearance **-> **Customize **->** Content -> Post Meta.**
- Scroll to locate **Typography. **
- Change the font size of the desired section.
- Click on **Publish**.

To manage the font size of Sidebar Title , follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, go to **Appearance **-> **Customize **->** Content -> Sidebar**
- Scroll to locate **Typography. **
- Change the font size of the desired section.
- Click on **Publish**.

## How to Change Font Size of Post/Page Title?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-font-size-of-post-page-title/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

You can manage font size of Post/Page title in a single view.

Follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, go to **Appearance **-> **Customize **-> **Content -> Page Header**
- Scroll to locate **Typography.**
- Select the option available from the drop-down list in ** Page title and Post title in single view.**
- Click on **Publish**.

## How to Change Font Family on the site?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-font-family-on-the-site/>

Spacious theme provides typography option from which you can select the fonts for your site.

- From the Dashboard, go to **Appearance > Customize > Global > Typography **
- Choose the font which you desired for your site from the options available there.
- Click on **Publish**.
